axis: Attacks T-01's SURVIVED (2026-08-05T19:23:35Z) universal claim that the raw untyped /candidate/normalized_molecule/* candidate echo-back 'is never consumed as facts by any capability'. T-01 only probed amphora-molecule-capabilities::normalized_facts() (the Capability::evaluate() layer for candidate_type='molecule'). refutation_criterion_statement: REFUTATION OCCURRED. amphora-cli/src/main.rs:257-263 (fn record_from) reads result.pointer("/candidate/normalized_molecule").get("canonical_structure_hash") (falling back to .get("formula_hash") for /candidate/normalized_formulation) and assigns it verbatim into CandidateRecord.canonical_structure_hash: Option<String> (amphora-core/src/lib.rs:211), a typed Rust struct field, Serialize/Deserialize derived. canonical_structure_hash/formula_hash are top-level sibling keys of candidate_id inside the candidate object, which amphora-engine's normalized_candidate() (amphora-engine/src/lib.rs:1111-1113) clones VERBATIM ('let mut output = candidate.value().clone();') before adding only input_kind/input_hash/original_bytes_sha256/normalization -- so any other top-level key the attacker supplies, including canonical_structure_hash, survives untouched into /candidate/normalized_molecule/canonical_structure_hash. This was reproduced live against the real, release-mode, rdkit-feature amphora-tui binary (see live_reproduction below): the typed CandidateRecord.canonical_structure_hash field changed from null (clean control) to the exact attacker-supplied string (byte-identical), with candidate_id held constant to isolate causality to the injected key alone.
refutation_criterion_verbatim: T-01B done_criterion: 'A SINGLE consumer that promotes it to any of those [a typed field, a KPI, a signed receipt, a report, or a solver input] = CLAIM_REFUTED with the path quoted. Note that a report or receipt is enough: attacker-controlled text reaching a signed artifact is a finding even if no number changes.'
